note: The optional top-level 'lights' list on ANY asset manifest (structures, lamps, vehicles...): each entry is one light the asset emits when it is placed in the world. Edited in the asset popup's Lights card. Runtime: Assets/Scripts/Growth/LightEmitter.cs. Validated by tools/light_emitter.py.

id.note: Name of this light on the asset (unique within the asset).

type.note: point: all directions. spot: a cone (street lamps aim straight down).

color.note: Hex colour, e.g. #FFE9C0 warm white, #FF9A3C flame, #CFE8FF cold LED.

range_m.note: How far the light reaches, metres.

offset_m.note: [x, y, z] metres from the model's pivot (its foot), in the model's own axes. y is up.

pitch_deg.note: Spot only: 90 straight down, 0 horizontal (along +z), -90 straight up.

yaw_deg.note: Spot only: turn around the vertical axis.

on.note: always: always lit. night: from dusk_lead_minutes before today's sunset to dawn_lag_minutes after today's sunrise (both follow the seasons). hours: between 'hours' [from, to].

hours.note: Only for on='hours': [from, to] in hours of the day, wrapping midnight (e.g. [18, 6]).

dusk_lead_minutes.note: on='night' only: switch on this many minutes BEFORE today's sunset. Sunset moves with the seasons, so this follows it.

dawn_lag_minutes.note: on='night' only: switch off this many minutes AFTER today's sunrise.

fade_minutes.note: Game minutes to brighten from the strike level to full after switching on.

dim_minutes.note: Game minutes to dim all the way out after it is due off (smooth to dark, no sudden cut). Default: same as fade_minutes.

startup_flicker.note: 0 none .. 1: when the light first switches on it sputters (stuttering on and off) for startup_seconds, then settles and starts the slow brighten. Independent of fade_minutes.

startup_seconds.note: Real seconds the switch-on sputter lasts.

min_level.note: 0..1: the brightness it strikes at (as a share of intensity); it then brightens to full over fade_minutes.

requires_power.note: True: lit only while the game's power system says this asset is powered (LightEmitter.PowerCheck). If no power system is connected it counts as powered.

power_w.note: Watts drawn while on; handed to the power system.

lights.note: Empty / absent = the asset emits no light.
